notes.title: Visual Update - New Briefing Cutscenes (1.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/4361b757d915a69c6cbe00d985ee007ad15ebf35.png[/img]

Hey chummers and chooms,
The game has been updated to [b]version 1.3.2[/b], once again bringing visual improvements to the game to enhance the immersion and player fantasy.

[h2]New Heist briefing cutscenes[/h2]
From very early in development, we knew we wanted the crew to have these snappy briefing dialogues where they go over the heist plan, just like in movies like Mission: Impossible or Ocean's Eleven.

But as we got into the later stages of development, it became clear that with our limitations—mainly the time left until release—it would be the best candidate for a cut if we didn’t want the rest of the game to suffer. Since all of the VOs were already recorded, we decided to implement a 'less expensive' solution as briefing dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/b5e64b18c40c53786b396d3e9c239dbb77d54efb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/572a9ca61459d2cb762666a08a534d3fe8bcf36c.png[/img]

With this update, we're finally bringing the briefing cutscenes back. They're done in the same motion comics style as the rest of the cutscenes in the game. To see how they look in action, check out the video of the briefing for the first heist below:

[previewyoutube=xdduI24EAFE;full][/previewyoutube]

So together with Update 1.1.0 bringing new combat animations, VFX and visual progression to the hub
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1982940/view/523078071951032586?l=english

and Update 1.2.0 polishing up all of the combat environments
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1982940/view/503940938959160160?l=english

this marks the end of our Visual Update trilogy, and the game now has all the visual content we originally planned for it.

[h2]The Storyteller's Festival 2025 Discount[/h2]

Last but not least, HeistGeist is also part of the [b]Storyteller's Festival[/b], organized by the lovely folks at Two and a Half Studios, celebrating the best storytelling in video games. Be sure to check out all the cool games!

For the duration of the festival, our game, as well as the soundtrack, will be [b]20% off[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47991/Game_with_Soundtrack/

As always, should you have any questions, or wanted to chat, write a comment or join our Discord.

Cheers and have a good one!

notes.title: Major Visual Update (1.1.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/dc2fc4e0571baf1354d6e839a5797b30d36c8167.png[/img]

Hey chummers and chooms,
The game has been updated to [b]version 1.1.0[/b]! This is one of our biggest updates yet, bringing mostly visual improvements to enhance the immersion of your experience.

[h2]New Combat animations[/h2]
With Alex's arsenal boasting over 40 cards, creating a custom animation for each proved a bit too ambitious for the release. However, with this update, we're adding nearly 20 new animations to her attacks and actions, including:
[list]
[*] Adrenaline Surge
[*] Backstab
[*] Battle Frenzy
[*] Careful Planning
[*] Combat Stim
[*] Death's Shadow
[*] Flow
[*] Focus
[*] Kick
[*] Monowire
[*] Neurotoxin
[*] Poison Blades
[*] Pommel Hit
[*] Risky Gamble
[*] Sloppy Patch-Up
[*] Slow Blade
[*] Snakebite
[*] Throwing Blades
[/list]
[list]
[*] Many enemy actions have also been enhanced with new VFX that were previously missing. 
[/list]
[h2]Caroline hub visual progression[/h2]
When Alex and the crew plan their next heist aboard the Caroline, we’ve always felt the environment had room to enhance immersion and storytelling. With this update, the hub now evolves during each Intermission, visually reflecting the story's progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/0e2b9d69401e9b5ea1a93c63b4e524194d01b73d.png[/img]


You can check it all out in this video:

[previewyoutube=gK3PMojnzqY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Other improvements & fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 8 new story event pictures
[*] Added new image for Heist 7 loading screen
[*] Fixed Valibuk’s combat animations
[*] Added an option to change text size (especially useful when playing on Steam Deck)
[*] Made major corrections and edits to the Czech localization
[*] Increased Omnislash card damage from 8 to 10
[/list]

[h2]Steam Winter Sale[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

And last but not least, for the duration of the Steam Winter Sale, the game will be [b]20% off[/b]. You can also grab it in one of the sweet bundles - either with our fantastic soundtrack from Robert Bruckmayer or with a wonderful cyberpunk deckbuilder Zero Division.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47991/Game_with_Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47624/Cyberpunk_Card_Battler/

So, Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: New DEMO update and the start of Combat PLAYTEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/4710b8410551a505afc6733f23ebc2138434b964.png[/img]
Hey everyone! 
Our demo has received a hefty new update, adding new content and enhancing the polish and fidelity of nearly every aspect of the gameplay.

We’ve also launched a brand new store page for the demo. (Please consider leaving us a review to help us gain more visibility for the game!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200/HeistGeist_Demo/

[h2]Demo Update [/h2]
So, what's new in the demo?
[list]
[*] [b]Character Screen[/b] - Now you can inspect the stats of your character and alter them with...
[*] [b]Cyberware[/b] - A major RPG component of the game is the ability to buy Cyberware in the Black Market, which is now available in the hub. (You earn the money you need by completing the demo mission, and you can then try it out in the Combat Simulator.)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/6df6a8a4d49588e4c1b470779064ab0e85ca1757.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] New and better combat tutorial - now explaining how the card types and the combo mechanic works.
[*] Improved combat UI with a better communication of when your combo is online.
[*] [b]Improved card animations and handling[/b] - Based on the feedback we received, we’ve completely overhauled how you interact with the cards. The new system feels much smoother and is now on par with the standards you’d expect from the genre.
[*] Improved combat animations and VFX.
[*] Quite a lot of UI improvements of pretty much every screen in the game.
[*] [b]Enemy inspect screen[/b] - A brand new UI screen that allows you to take a closer look at each enemy, inspect their stats, and see the cards they can play.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/6316b5ba50ec3208b61d75eebcbb479c4a67c0e3.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Full map of the city - You can explore the city and imagine where the story of the game will take you.
[*] [b]New Music[/b] - We've added another track to combat and a special music track for boss battles. There’s also a brand new music track for the hub and world map.
[*] The way music is handled has also changed, so it should no longer get abruptly interrupted when you change screens.
[*] [b]Xbox controller support[/b] - The demo should be fully playable with an Xbox controller. If you find anything that isn’t working as expected, be sure to let us know.
[/list]
[h2]Start of the Combat PLAYTEST[/h2]
Even though HeistGeist is a story-focused RPG, the card combat constitutes a significant part of the game. With more than 40 cards, each with two different upgrades, there’s plenty of room for discovering powerful combinations and builds, as well as playstyles that might not meet expectations. This is where we’d like to ask for your help

[b]Want to take part? You can either request access on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/]Steam store page for the main game[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/HgrJJfK7Ky]join our Discord[/url] and let us know.[/b] Once we’re ready for a new batch of testers, we’ll invite some of you to the playtest. We expect it to run until we’re satisfied with the combat and plan to close it a few weeks before the game’s release.

Oh, and one more thing: if you like the game so far and haven’t done so yet, please consider adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b]. Thank you chooms and chummers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

notes.title: 2023 Recap: A look back at what we got done this past year
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/cb066b227624554874080f6325a45051f74325cd.png[/img]

Hey folks, looking back on 2023, it's been a wild ride for our game development journey. Before we step into the new year, let's rewind and appreciate the significant milestones that made it special.

[h2][b]January[/b][/h2]
In January, we released our [b]very first HeistGeist demo[/b], offering everyone a sneak peek into the envisioned look and feel of the final game. The demo is continuously updated with each new feature implementation. Feel free to try it out anytime to get an idea of what it currently looks like.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200

[h2][b]February[/b][/h2]
In the week of February 6-13, we dived headfirst into the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], swimming in a pool of positive and constructive feedback. This event marked our first opportunity to showcase the game to a broad audience. Despite our initial concerns, the reception was pretty great. It gave us a reality check on whether our game was hitting the mark.

Throughout February and March, our focus was dedicated to reviewing player feedback and making crucial game design decisions and implementations. We concentrated on enhancing visual clarity and adding controller support.
[h2][b]March[/b][/h2]
From March 21 to April 1, we participated in the online festival [b]"The Storyteller's Festival."[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/d086380d79de05ea9ae143dfc967ab709ddd7e80.png[/img]
[h2][b]April[/b][/h2]
In April, we made a significant overhaul of the hacking mechanic.

From April 24 to 26, we participated in the prestigious [b]REBOOT Develop Blue[/b] conference in Dubrovnik (Croatia), where we showcased the game. This marked our fourth appearance at this conference, but the first time post-pandemic, adding a chill holiday flavor to the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/81c77c20b5f8526a8a887c7286eb85d56c70bceb.png[/img]
[h2][b]May[/b][/h2]
In May, we incorporated Guardian nodes into the hacking mechanic and introduced the combat simulator mode to assist in testing combat mechanics and balancing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/3866936db989a9a0740417cdd471dc39029cc558.png[/img]
[h2][b]June[/b][/h2]
On June 2-3, we were part of the [b]Game Access conference[/b] in Brno (Czech Republic), likely the biggest and coolest conference around. It was a lot of fun, meeting both familiar and new faces, and walked away with the "Best Art Award"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/ac692995fc30e11c84dbf7bb6682e611bfb4fd6d.png[/img]
Throughout the summer, our focus was on writing – developing the story, dialogues, and events for each heist, methodically tackling level design intricacies one level at a time. We crafted dialogue scripts for voice actors, and proofread texts, and this has remained an ongoing task ever since.
[h2][b]August[/b][/h2]
In August, we added and reworked numerous VFX effects. We introduced several new status effects to spice up battles and included new enemy types. Furthermore, we wrapped up the implementation of the first iteration of full [b]controller and Steam Deck support.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/9853c04b3886991daf31482cea39c5b1f8c17b5f.png[/img]
From August 28 to September 4, we participated in the online festival [b]Steam Strategy Fest.[/b]
[h2][b]September[/b][/h2]
In September, we tackled the conceptual, visual, and mechanical design of most in-game enemies.  Additionally, we successfully implemented a significant portion of UI screens and elements.
[h2][b]October[/b][/h2]
In October, our amazing composer, [url=https://robertbruckmayer.com/]Robert Bruckmayer[/url], completed work on a truly breathtaking soundtrack for our game.

We had a blast at Game Days Kosice from October 26 to 28! It's the biggest (and only) conference for game developers in Slovakia and an awesome event, especially for our local community. The atmosphere is super friendly.
[h2][b]November[/b][/h2]
In November, we crafted an entirely new story trailer, featuring numerous fresh shots from the game, showcasing enemies, new battle screens, and a sneak peek into a couple of story elements from the final game. This trailer was featured in the showcase at the online Steam festival [b]"Czech & Slovak Games Week,"[/b] held from November 13 to 20. Additionally, we participated in the parallel online festival [b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b] from November 14 to 21. Moreover, we finally implemented the long-awaited dynamic camera into battles, which, if you ask me, is pretty awesome.

[previewyoutube=9XIj4TFq0jE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]December[/b][/h2]
December is like the Friday of the year, a time when we aimed to tackle unfinished tasks. However, the COVID gods had different plans, and practically all of us fell ill at different times during the month. This threw a wrench into our planning and management, disrupting things just before the Christmas holidays. Fortunately we’re all fine now.

---------------------------

The next year is shaping up to be a significant one for us. We're gearing up to kick off the beta testing phase for our combat system and gradually move closer to the release of HeistGeist. It's a mix of scary and exciting stuff.

In the meantime, enjoy your holidays, spend some quality time with your loved ones, eat some good food, and we'll catch up with you all in the new year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/b9f8af2d4844f5f05cb51ebbaf5c9f1d227c9ae8.png[/img]

Thanks for reading this far! If you haven't yet, we'd love for you to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/HgrJJfK7Ky]Discord[/url]. You can chat with us and be the first to know when beta testing begins. Also, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.threads.net/@doublequotestudio]Threads[/url] for the latest updates, and consider adding [url=s.team/a/1982940 ]HeistGeist[/url] to your Steam wishlist. We greatly appreciate your support!

notes.title: HeistGeist Demo updated for the Steam Strategy Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/2072c3bb055855735fa1b3a912b5505f90f1ab08.png[/img]

Our game HeistGeist is a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/strategy/]Steam Strategy Fest[/url]. For this occasion, we've prepared a substantial update to our demo.

If you haven't tried the demo of our game yet, this may be a good opportunity to do so! If you do, please, consider giving us feedback through our [url=https://www.heistgeist.com/links/survey]survey[/url] and adding our game to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200

[h2]New demo gameplay trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=_crRSAVLyWE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new in the d1.1.1 update[/h2]

[h3][b]Combat improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved communication of when you have the combo ready[/b] - When the combo condition for a card you are about to play has been met, the card now displays a visible golden glow. An animation has been added to the last played card indicator, making it easier to follow.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/9853c04b3886991daf31482cea39c5b1f8c17b5f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New Visual Effects (VFX)[/b] - Several new visual effects (VFX) have been added to nearly all attack animations, for both Alexandra and her enemies. We've also added impact VFX for various damage types: slashes, stabs, shots, electricity, poison, and more.
[*] [b]Notifications[/b] - Every time a character in combat receives a status effect or their HP value is changed, a notification pops up next to them.
[*] [b]Change to Shield visuals[/b] - Now, when a character with a shield is attacked, a special animation is played, showing the shield being impacted. There's also a special animation for when the shield gets destroyed.
[*] [b]Improved combat animations[/b] - Work continues.
[*] [b]New cards[/b] - Six new cards have been added for you to try out. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/fb8f35b3c72914bc494c271009f3db66aa82935b.png[/img]
[h3][b]*NEW* Combat Simulator[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A new type of 'mission' accessible from the city map. This involves a series of combat encounters in which you can try out the new cards and experiment with different deckbuilding strategies
[/list]
[h3][b]Hacking overhaul[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Visual improvements[/b] - 
[*] [b]Tooltips[/b] - When a Node on the grid is hovered over, it now displays a tooltip with all the necessary information about it. This eliminates the need to refer back to the tutorial when you're uncertain about remembering something correctly.
[*] [b]Card effect preview[/b] - When you target a node with a card, the effect it will have is now previewed on the grid. This informs you about how the strength of the node will change, or whether it will be captured or destroyed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/3866936db989a9a0740417cdd471dc39029cc558.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Guardian Node[/b] - New type of ICE Node that you will have to overcome
[*] [b]Garbage Node[/b] - New type of Node that you can use to discard cards you currently don't have a good use for, so that they wouldn't take up precious memory space.
[/list]
[h3][b]New Music[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New music tracks have been added to the heist map and hacking.
[*] All of the music tracks have been broken down into individual instruments with a predetermined chance of being played. This ensures that when the track loops, it sounds different from before.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/152c99f17a951774221d917c49987b4aa4bdd36d.png[/img]
[h3][b]*NEW* Controller and Steam Deck support[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The game should be fully playable with an Xbox controller and also on the Steam Deck. This marks the first iteration of this feature, so we're very much open to your feedback. We're also aware that some of the text on the Deck might be a bit too small; that's something we plan to work on.
[/list]
You can let us know what you think in the comment, on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]Twitter[/url] (I refuse to call it X) or [url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE]Discord[/url] or use our [url=https://www.heistgeist.com/links/survey]survey[/url].
If you liked the demo, please be sure to add the game to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

notes.title: HeistGeist - Development Update (Spring 2023)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/6dc6ca42389a41b3dd535459f101148de397bd04.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We wanted to take a moment to update you on what we've been up to over the past few months, as well as what we're currently working on and what we have planned for the near future.

[h2]Reboot Develop Blue 2023[/h2]
Last week (April 24-26, 2023), we had the pleasure of attending the Reboot Develop Blue conference in (mostly) sunny Dubrovnik, Croatia – one of our favorite events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/81c77c20b5f8526a8a887c7286eb85d56c70bceb.png[/img]
At our demo booth, we unveiled the first version of our experimental Combat Simulator, a mission that challenges players to fight their way through increasingly difficult enemies. We also previewed four new cards that we're currently testing out.

Aside from gathering valuable feedback from the developer community, we had the opportunity to connect with fellow developers and try out several exciting new games. Among our favorites were [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826400/CRAVE/]Crave[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584410/Wicked_Lands/]Wicked Lands[/url], and [url=http://tacticaldeception.com/]Tactical Deception[/url], to name a few.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200

[h2]What we're working on[/h2]

Apart from attending conferences, we were also hard at work finishing up all the game's features and creating content. 

[h3]Controller and Steam Deck support[/h3]

The first thing we'd like to mention is the controller and Steam Deck support that we've been working on. We're excited to report that we have a functioning prototype, which is working quite well. However, it has also highlighted some areas that still need to be addressed to achieve the high-quality experience we're aiming for, such as text size on smaller screens and intuitive navigation on the heist map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/152c99f17a951774221d917c49987b4aa4bdd36d.png[/img]
We'll keep you updated on our progress, and we'll let you know when it's ready to be tested in the demo.

[h3]Content - Story, levels, enemies and cards [/h3]

We're also hard at work creating new content for the game, including writing the game's story, designing levels, and creating new enemies and cards.

[list]
[*] [b]Story & Levels[/b] - In the demo, you got a small taste of the game, but there is so much more to Alex and her crew's story. We have the story outline completed and are currently transforming it into individual levels with unique story events and dialogues. Players can look forward to meeting plenty of cool new characters and experiencing thrilling heists in locations inspired by real existing buildings.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/a8bf9a60b22169803e68e5e4b0bb64afbca2004c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemies[/b] - Rather than talk about them, we'd like to give you a sneak peek of some of the enemis that will do everything in their power to stop Alex and her crew from achieving their goal.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/288a90dcb305b65d67066e27170093f8d654b239.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/bc728bfc9b6750a7aec47404dc5f16921d8fcd33.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Cards[/b] - As for the cards, we're working on adding new cards for Alex to add a couple more archetypes to build your deck towards. While they still revolve around her signature combo mechanic, these new cards will introduce fresh mechanics and tactics for players to utilize. 
We will talk about them a bit more in a few months, when we'll be also looking for testers who would like to give these new archetypes a try.
[*] [b]Hacking[/b] - We're also working on the next iteration of the hacking mechanic, which will add a new special type of barrier nodes called Guardians to the grid. In addition, we'll be introducing some more UX and quality of life improvements. 
[/list]
[h2]Game Access 2023[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/85a0ad9e655205130c2c07004fcec2ec1c10f179.png[/img]
Next up, we'll be attending the Game Access 2023 conference in Brno, Czech Republic, where we'll be showcasing some of the features we've mentioned above. You'll be able to try them out in our demo, along with many other cool games that will be showcased at the event. If you don't have any plans for June 2-3, 2023, consider stopping by and say hi!

[h2]Wrap up[/h2]

Thanks for reading this far! If you haven't yet, we'd love for you to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/JPtu8RyT]Discord[/url]. You can chat with us and be the first to know when beta testing begins. Also, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]Twitter[/url] for the latest updates, and consider adding [url=s.team/a/1982940 ]HeistGeist[/url] to your Steam wishlist. We greatly appreciate your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

notes.title: HeistGeist Demo updated for The Storyteller's Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/4a24a1427ee782868618ee2a83c209663ac0d378.png[/img]

Our game HeistGeist is being a part of the first issue of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival]Storyteller's Festival[/url][/b] here on Steam. The demo of our game received a new update with multiple small, but important changes, that we'd like to tell you more about below.

If you haven't tried the demo of our game yet, this may be a good opportunity to do so! If you do, please, consider giving us feedback through our survey and adding our game to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200

[h2]What's new in the d1.0.10 update[/h2]

[h3]Choice events[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Change to the screen layout[/b] - Outcomes of your choices are now shown on the right side of the screen in a form of a list
[*] [b]Updated typography[/b] - We have changed the default font, adjusted the spacing and font sizes of various texts, to make them more pleasant to read
[*] [b]Dynamic image change[/b] - The title image associated with each event can now sometimes change to better illustrate what's taking place in the event
[*] [b]More character animations[/b] - The characters on the left side of the screen are now more reactive to what's happening in the particular events
[*] [b]Animated text[/b] - The texts of the event are now revealed gradually as they fade-in onto the screen over a short period of time 
[*] [b]New texts[/b] - Pretty much all of the texts of the Choice Events went through rewrites, stylistic changes and proofreading
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/d086380d79de05ea9ae143dfc967ab709ddd7e80.png[/img]

[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Simplified card texts[/b] - Introduced a new keyword Combo, that replaced the usually quite wordy explanation of how playing the cards in sequence work. The explanation has now moved to the card tooltip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/5ccbfba4594b7c3b9486d1bbd9b3c9e7be1da250.png[/img]

[*] [b]Camera Shake[/b] - Due to a mistake, all the attacks and hits lacked the proper impact before, but not anymore!
[*] [b]Replaced Vigilance with Payback[/b]  - The Vigilance status effect is now replaced with a new, similar status effect, called Payback. It reads: [i]Payback [X] - When this character is attacked, they deal [X] damage to the attacker. Lasts for one turn. [/i]
[*] [b]Special attack animations for combos[/b] - Currently experimental. When you meet the combo requirement of playing a card in sequence with card of a certain type, it now has a slightly different animation.
[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Subtitles in cutscenes[/b] - Added english subtitles to all three cutscenes present in the demo.
[/list]

You can let us know what you think on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE]Discord[/url] or use our [url=https://www.heistgeist.com/links/survey  https://www.heistgeist.com/links/discord]survey[/url]

notes.title: HeistGeist Demo out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/9b6cfdb0183b6a4f01a72144a7409118c2d8dcc1.jpg[/img]

HeistGeist's first public demo is now available as part of the Steam Next Fest, offering just a taste of the full vision for the game. If you're intrigued, we invite you to give it a try and let us know what you think. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we work towards realizing our full vision for HeistGeist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255200

So, what can you experience in the demo?

[h2]A proper cyberpunk heist[/h2]

HeistGeist is a cyberpunk RPG in which you plan and undertake thrilling heists. The demo offers you a glimpse of one of our missions, in which you attempt to steal a valuable piece of tech from a data vault in the Archives. But as is to be expected, things rarely go according to plan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/3498b920e1b42295f837eb1065228807d063b2e6.png[/img]

[h2]Card-based combat full of combos[/h2]
In our game, the sequencing of how you play your cards matters. Unleash a rain of damage on you enemies when you play the cards in a right order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/99aa297d31f5e092a0436149a2c4bc80b73f078d.png[/img]

[h2]Hack the grid[/h2]
Hack into the most secure corporate systems in our reimagination of cyberspace net running with a special card-based puzzle mechanic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/62b22a5cdefe173c84a798826f839eb481375a1a.png[/img]

[h2]Get to know your crew[/h2]
You can't pull off a proper heist on your own. Talk to the crew and get a glimpse of the story that awaits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/9bdf71d675c702a0d6652adf6483dc820e01a044.png[/img]

If you liked the demo, please be sure to add the game to your wishlist and let us know what you think on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE]Discord[/url] or use our [url=https://www.heistgeist.com/links/survey  https://www.heistgeist.com/links/discord]survey[/url]

notes.title: HeistGeist is a part of #TurnBasedFest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/f83d52774a7e9e9ca0997b616163eb01fe02d54f.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just wanted to let you know that our game is a part of the first ever [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43077188/sale/TurnBasedFest]#TurnBasedFest[/url] - a five-day long online festival celebrating turn-based video games, put together by the great folks from the [url=https://twitter.com/TurnBasedThurs]#TurnBasedThursday[/url] twitter community. Be sure to check out all the cool upcoming games, demos and discounts.

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43077188/sale/TurnBasedFest

And our game, HeistGeist has the honor of being a part of this awesome event.

[h2]What is HeistGeist?[/h2]

So, if you're new here, you might be asking "What even is HeistGeist?" You can take a look at our first dev diary, in which we introduce the game a little more.

[previewyoutube=YATl_KvCtlk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]HeistGeist[/b] is a narrative-focused RPG set in a cyberpunk vision of central europe. You follow the story of Alexandra, a professional thief for hire. After her last job went terribly bad, Alex is on the run from corporate assassins and an unhappy client, as she tries to put together a team of specialists to pull off a heist of a lifetime.

In HeistGeist you plan and execute highly sophisticated heists for super secret prototypes or classified corporate intel. But even the best laid plans can sometimes get messy.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1982940/extras/gif2.gif[/img]

If stealth is not an option, you fight guards and automated security systems in card based battles. You build a deck suitable to your playstyle, play the right cards and unleash powerful combinations on your enemies. 

Or you can attempt to hack your way into the most secure corporate systems in our reimagination of cyberspace net running with a special card-based hacking mechanics. 

[h2]Keep yourself in the loop[/h2]

If you think this is something that might be relevant to your interests, you can add the game to your wishlist or follow out progress on [url=https://twitter.com/HeistGeistGame]twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE]Discord[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/

[h3]Discord[/h3]
Last but not least, we are currently in the process of putting together our first public demo. We are also on the lookout for beta-testers with an affinity for card games, RPGs and cyberpunk. If this is something you'd be interested in, or just want to stay in touch, [url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE]join our Discord[/url] today!

[url=https://discord.gg/Gcv5tjaCxE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465979/62044332971cf36845d2e0be355068c368aeb54d.png[/img][/url]
